name: dispatch-guard
description: One-plugin marketplace: this repository is both the marketplace and the plugin it lists, so `claude plugin marketplace add Dino9021/dispatch-guard` followed by `claude plugin install dispatch-guard@dispatch-guard` is the whole installation.

plugins.name: dispatch-guard
plugins.description: Makes sub-agent dispatch discipline binding instead of advisory, and refuses to dispatch once the usage window is nearly spent. One sub-task at a time unless the owner approves a count; the plan and every sub-task prompt land on disk before any dispatch; every outcome is recorded; and a one-shot resume can be armed for after the window reopens. Ships two skills: dispatch-protocol, and unattended-work for long stretches with nobody watching. Standard-library Python only - nothing to install.
